scenario.summary: This article outlines common attacker behaviors observed across endpoint and identity planes, including credential stuffing against VPNs, the use of encoded PowerShell for execution, and persistence via unauthorized RMM tools like ScreenConnect. The intrusion culminates in credential theft via LSASS dumping and the destruction of system recovery options like volume shadow copies to maximize impact.

hunt.name: Identity and Cloud Access Anomalies
hunt.description: This hunt detects accounts under brute-force or MFA fatigue pressure and links them to rare geographic logins and unauthorized inbox forwarding. It connects identity compromise to data collection by joining authentication telemetry with cloud API logs. The flow evaluates authentication anomalies alongside geographic rarity and endpoint impact indicators like LSASS memory access or system recovery inhibition.

config.content: SELECT LOWER(actor_user_name) AS user, COUNT(CASE WHEN activity_id = 5 THEN 1 END) AS failures, COUNT(CASE WHEN activity_id = 1 AND (LOWER(actor_user_name) LIKE '%svc-%' OR LOWER(actor_user_name) LIKE '%service%') THEN 1 END) AS service_logons, MIN(time) AS first_attempt, MAX(time) AS last_attempt FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY LOWER(actor_user_name) HAVING failures >= {{mfa_failure_threshold}} OR service_logons > 0 ORDER BY failures DESC
config.description: Identify users with high failure rates or service accounts logging into interactive services.
config.expected_signal: Rows identify users targeted by brute-force or service accounts acting as users. Silence suggests no detected identity-level hammering.

primitive_config.label: Authentication Anomaly Lead
primitive_config.content: SELECT LOWER(actor_user_name) AS user, COUNT(CASE WHEN activity_id = 5 THEN 1 END) AS failures, COUNT(CASE WHEN activity_id = 1 AND (LOWER(actor_user_name) LIKE '%svc-%' OR LOWER(actor_user_name) LIKE '%service%') THEN 1 END) AS service_logons, MIN(time) AS first_attempt, MAX(time) AS last_attempt FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY LOWER(actor_user_name) HAVING failures >= {{mfa_failure_threshold}} OR service_logons > 0 ORDER BY failures DESC
primitive_config.expected: Rows identify users targeted by brute-force or service accounts acting as users. Silence suggests no detected identity-level hammering.

config.content: SELECT src_location_country, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_name) AS distinct_users, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE activity_id = 1 AND ('{{scope_users}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_users}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(actor_user_name) || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY src_location_country HAVING distinct_users <= {{rare_country_threshold}}
config.description: Identify logins from countries that are rare for the organization or identified users.
config.expected_signal: A list of countries associated with very few users, suggesting attacker infrastructure.

config.content: SELECT time, actor_user_name, api_operation, target_modified_property_new_values FROM hb_cloud_api_activity WHERE provider = 'm365' AND LOWER(api_operation) IN ('new-inboxrule', 'set-inboxrule') AND (instr(LOWER(target_modified_property_new_values), 'forwardto') > 0 OR instr(LOWER(target_modified_property_new_values), 'redirectto') > 0) AND ('{{scope_users}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_users}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(actor_user_name) || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Search for Microsoft 365 inbox rule creations that redirect mail to external recipients.
config.expected_signal: Cloud API records of users modifying inbox rules to redirect email. Silence is evidence of absence if logs are complete.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_cmd_line, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%vssadmin%delete%shadows%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%wbadmin%delete%catalog%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%bcdedit%/set%recoveryenabled%no%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%mimikatz%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%procdump%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Check for LSASS memory access or recovery inhibition on the scoped hosts.
config.expected_signal: Any row indicates an attempt to sabotage recovery or dump credentials on a host involved in the authentication anomalies.
